visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark brown hair and straight bangs, wearing a navy-and-white horizontal striped polo shirt, stands before an off-white interior wall. She smiles warmly at the camera and waves with her right hand. The lighting is bright and even. (2) She holds up a white circular tub with silver lettering towards the lens with both hands. A motion graphic overlay highlights the product. Her eyes are wide and facial expression is enthusiastic. (3) She opens the white tub's lid to reveal a solid white balm inside. She points her index finger at the balm while maintaining eye contact with the lens. A white electric fan is partially visible in the background on the right. (4) Close-up shots show her using a small white spatula to scoop a portion of the white balm onto her palm, then rubbing it. She applies the balm to her cheeks with her fingers in circular motions. (5) A different angle shows her arm under a silver metal tap with running water. She rubs her skin as the water washes away red and black makeup residue. (6) She wipes her damp face with a white cotton pad, looking into the camera. (7) Macro close-up of her nose shows clear skin. Animated sparkle icons are overlaid on her face. She touches her nose and cheeks to demonstrate smoothness. (8) Close-up shot of the product's bottom label, which features Japanese text and the clear bold text 'MADE IN JAPAN'. (9) She holds the product container again, gesturing with her hand toward the upper frame while speaking rapidly. She waves goodbye at the end.

(2) A 'whoosh' SFX triggers as a product name is mentioned, followed by a slight rise in vocal pitch. (3) The rhythmic synth beat remains steady at approximately 125 BPM while the narration explains product benefits at a high speech density. (4) A distinct sound of running water from a tap occurs, accompanied by wet splashing/rubbing noises. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the SFX to be heard. (5) Soft rustling of a cotton pad is audible during a scene transition. (6) A 'twinkle' chime SFX triggers as sparkle graphics appear, blending with the speaker's enthusiastic delivery. (7) A final 'pop' SFX and a melodic stinger in the BGM conclude the recording as the speaker finishes her call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Product Intro -> Feature Demonstration -> Result/Evidence -> Price/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a persuasive promotional review for COCOCHI cleansing balm. The creator uses her 8-year influencer reputation as social proof to recommend the product, followed by visual demonstrations of its makeup-removing efficacy and its impact on skin clarity (blackhead removal). It concludes with a direct sales call-to-action regarding a group-buy price.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product recommendation, close-up brand display, and mention of a group-buy discounted price.
